about: Real consumer queries for the #283 performance and proof-size gate (TR-081). Budgets: budgets.json. Gate: crates/ordeal/tests/perf_gate_corpus.rs. A query's consumer_api block is what the consumer's own API call produced when the query was taken (that ordeal version, that build), recorded for the reader-fidelity check.

consumers_not_covered.reason: spar's main has no ordeal dependency (Cargo.lock has no ordeal; spar#327 was withdrawn, spar#350 is an open proposal), so there is no real spar query to take. The two spar/* entries are labelled synthetic stand-ins from ordeal's own bmc_corpus and are not counted as real.

excluded.what: ordeal#314: 128-bit (and 64-bit) bvudiv by a power-of-two constant
excluded.reason: a liveness gap the built-in search does not decide in minutes; it would make the gate measure a timeout, not a regression. Bounded separately by `ordeal check --timeout-ms` (TR-093).
